efficio_render_behavior.purpose: Tells the renderer how to treat the shape.

enum_descriptions.render_by_component_type: Render the shape using its component type contract.
enum_descriptions.preserve: Keep the shape exactly as authored; do not generate content for it.
enum_descriptions.remove_on_render: Drop the shape from the rendered output (mock/preview only).

efficio_prompt_instruction.purpose: Free-form instruction passed to content generation for this component.

efficio_text_format.purpose: Selects the structural format of generated text.

enum_descriptions.plain: A single run of plain text.

efficio_max_chars.purpose: Strict limit on the total number of characters the generated text may use. The generated content must never exceed it; shorten or compact the text until it fits.

efficio_max_lines.purpose: Strict limit on the number of lines the generated text may use. The generated content must never exceed it; shorten or compact the text until it fits.

efficio_max_chars_per_line.purpose: Strict limit on the number of characters in any single line of the generated text. Each line must never exceed it; shorten or compact each line until it fits.

expected_content_schema.description: Expected AI output for a text component.
